title: Controller B (Cancel/Cancel_Drag) and Start (Toggle_Pause) branches have zero scenario coverage; the Cancel_Drag escape-hatch intent is entirely untested
detail: All pad scripts press only Dpad_Down/A/bumpers; the pad's escape hatch (B mid-drag → Cancel_Drag), B deselect, and Start pause are new intent branches with no pin. A regression here is invisible to CI.
recommended_fix: Add pad scenarios: B mid-drag (drag abandoned, no command), B idle (deselects), Start (mode flips Paused); assert state plus no log entries.

title: pad_step boundary cases untested: Dpad_Up first-placement, wrap-around, dead-node skipping never run under test
detail: Only Dpad_Down-from-unset and +1 steps are scripted; the wrap (idx %= n), the -1 first-placement branch, and the alive-scan never run under test despite an explicit edge-hunter fix (finding 3).
recommended_fix: Script Dpad_Up from unset (lands on last alive node), down past the last node (wraps to 0), and a step over a demolished cursor node.

title: Command-stage rejection paths untested: every scenario's commands succeed; err != .None branches and the reject toast never execute
detail: The guards' 'invalid/out-of-contract intents are rejected' is only happy-path proven. Invalid draw (validate_draw), occupied-tile place, demolish-with-no-selection, and reject-toast surfacing (last_reject/reject_tick) are never exercised.
recommended_fix: Add negative scenarios: over-tier draw, occupied-tile placement, X with no selection, invalid lane edit; assert no command appended and last_reject/reject_tick set where the toast applies.

title: Game_Over retry surface (R/Enter, pad A) has no scenario; the mode-gated mappings run untested
detail: The terminal-run path — the only Game_Over input — has zero coverage: mouse Retry, pad Confirm, touch frozen. A retry regression (stale-state leak, ODN-13) would be invisible headless.
recommended_fix: Preset mode=.Game_Over (or drive health_lose), then script R/Enter and pad A; assert the retry hook fires once and no other intent executes.

title: Mouse transcription branches without pins: pause, assist, overlay, preview, ESC-deselect, right-while-placing (W3), drag-interrupt
evidence:
app/input/mouse.odin:66-75:
			case .P, .Space:
				append(out, Intent(Toggle_Pause{}))
			case .D:
				append(out, Intent(Toggle_Overlay{}))
			case .T:
				append(out, Intent(Toggle_Assist{}))
			case .Esc:
				if inp.placing >= 0 {
					esc_cancelled = true
				}
				append(out, Intent(Cancel{}))
app/input/mouse.odin:121-125 (the W3 right-while-placing transcription):
			if !esc_cancelled {
				append(out, Intent(Cancel{}))
			}
			append(out, Intent(Right_Click{pos = right_press}))
app/input/mouse.odin:232-236:
		case .U:
			// the R4 upgrade preview arm/disarm (a view-only look) — the
			// sel_pipe gate lives in the executor (a same-frame selection must
			// be the one the key acts on, like the old sequential code)
			append(out, Intent(Arm_Preview{}))
harness key events used across all scenarios: .One, .E, .X, .Esc only.
detail: The hard blocker is exact mouse preservation, yet 7 transcribed branches produce no intent in any scenario: P/Space, D, T, U, ESC-deselect, right-click-while-placing (W3), drag-interrupt. The W3 review fix is explicitly subtle and unpinned.
recommended_fix: Add mouse scenarios: ESC with nothing placing (deselect), ESC+right same frame (W3), right-click mid-drag (interrupt + swallow latch), P pause flip; assert state transitions.

title: Junction demolish through the input path (X on sel_node / popover button) untested; only demolish_pipe is pinned
detail: The select scenario proves junction selection (sel_node == 1 asserted), but no scenario follows it with X or the popover button — the Cmd_Demolish_Node input path (E27 batch) is never driven from the intent layer.
recommended_fix: Extend the demolish scenario: select the junction (n1), press X, expect Cmd_Demolish_Node{1} plus cleared selection; optionally click the popover button rect.

title: T1 goldens are first-blessed in this PR; 'mouse preserved exactly' has no pre-change baseline
detail: The goldens pin the NEW mouse behavior; the pre-5.4 handle_input was not headless-testable, so 'mouse preserved exactly' rests on transcription review plus the explicit expected streams, not regression data.
recommended_fix: Treat the explicit expected-command lists as the reviewable contract and state in the PR that mouse exactness is review-pinned; add a playtest checklist entry for the old controls.

title: Right-click scenario wires a mirrored duplicate of effect_right_click; app effect hooks stay nil — real hooks can drift untested
detail: parity_right_click_effect duplicates the app's effect_right_click body, so app-side drift is invisible; retry/assist/overlay/preview/glow/UI hooks stay nil in every run — zero headless coverage of the real effects.
recommended_fix: Extract effect_right_click (and the other hooks) into a shared file both the app and harness import, then wire real hooks into one scenario each.

title: Mixed-device frames never scripted: the fixed mouse→touch→controller dispatch order is unexercised
evidence:
app/main.odin:518-522 (the app merges all three pollers into one dispatch):
	inp.begin_frame(ictx)
	inp.poll_mouse(ictx)
	inp.poll_touch(ictx)
	inp.poll_controller(ictx)
	inp.dispatch_frame(ictx, ictx.events[:])
app/input/input.odin:115-125:
dispatch_frame :: proc(inp: ^Input, events: []Device_Event) {
	clear(&inp.intents)
	mouse_map(inp, events, &inp.intents)
	execute_all(inp, inp.intents[:])
	clear(&inp.intents)
	touch_map(inp, events, &inp.intents)
	execute_all(inp, inp.intents[:])
	clear(&inp.intents)
	controller_map(inp, events, &inp.intents)
	execute_all(inp, inp.intents[:])
}
Every parity scenario scripts a single device's events (mouse-only or touch-only or pad-only frames).
detail: The app merges all three pollers into one frame (main.odin:518-522), but every scenario scripts one device alone; the fixed mouse→touch→controller execution order is never exercised with mixed devices.
recommended_fix: Add one mixed-device scenario (e.g., mouse move + pad A in one frame) asserting the fixed dispatch order yields the mouse-equivalent command stream.

title: Advisory test gate: FAIL
evidence: Scenario roster (build_scenarios): input_parity_draw, input_parity_draw_wide, input_parity_select, input_parity_tier_cycle, input_parity_class_cycle, input_parity_pan, input_parity_lane, input_parity_demolish, input_parity_place, input_parity_cancel, input_parity_right_click. Cross-device equality + hash-stream equality + blessed goldens cover the draw/select/tier/class/pan happy paths; no scenario covers rejections, ESC-deselect, right-while-placing, pad B/Start, Game_Over, Dpad_Up/wrap, junction demolish, mixed-device frames (verified by grep over all scripted event constructors: Key_Press .One/.E/.X/.Esc; Pad .Dpad_Down/.A/.L_Bumper/.R_Bumper only).
detail: P0 ≈87% (mouse exactness ~65%, rejection proof ~60%, cross-input parity 100%, no-bypass 100%, no-serialization 100%, camera-fit 100%); P1 ≈66%; overall ≈70%. FAIL: P0 <100%, P1 <80%, overall <80%.
recommended_fix: Add the negative/boundary/auxiliary scenarios above (rejections, ESC-deselect, W3, pad B/Start/Game_Over, Dpad_Up/wrap, junction demolish, mixed-device frame); lifts P0 to 100%, P1 ≈90%, overall ≈85%.
